title: Intrinsic inverse-image coordinates and invertible mates
statement: For a finite commutative ring A, schemes X,S and an isomorphism e:X≅P¹_S over f, explicitly construct the comparison from fixed-scalar realization on S followed by actual intrinsic derived pullback to the projection inverse image followed by e inverse image and realization on X. In general, for adjunctions L⊣R and L′⊣R′, equivalences F:C→C′ and H:D→D′ and an isomorphism p:F L′≅L H, there is q:H R′≅R F such that unit′ at F(M), followed by R′(p_M) and q at L(M), equals F(unit_M) for every M.

proof.text: Identify the actual constant-ring pushforward with the intrinsic constant-module direct image using the inverse-image ring adjunction. Uniqueness of left adjoints supplies native pullback comparison. Derive it and compose the inverse-image composition and exact/left-derived comparisons along e and the projection.
Take the inverse of the mate of p. It is invertible by the equivalence-mate theorem. Postcompose unit_mateEquiv with its inverse and cancel.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteAdjunctionCoordinates
    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} {L' : C' ⥤ D'} {R' : D' ⥤ C'}
    (a : L ⊣ R) (b : L' ⊣ R') (F : C ⥤ C') (H : D ⥤ D')
    [F.IsEquivalence] [H.IsEquivalence] (p : F ⋙ L' ≅ L ⋙ H) :
    ∃ q : H ⋙ R' ≅ R ⋙ F,
      ∀ M, b.unit.app (F.obj M) ≫ R'.map (p.hom.app M) ≫
        q.hom.app (L.obj M) = F.map (a.unit.app M)
